name: escalation_error

worst_example.reply: Thank you for contacting AmazonHelp. We apologize for the inconvenience. Please give it until end of day today, and if it still doesn't arrive, we will arrange a full replacement or refund. Please let us know if you need any additional assistance.

pattern: Escalation decision was wrong (unnecessary escalation or missed escalation). May indicate threshold miscalibration.
proposed_fix: Re-examine threshold calibration on validation set. Check if specific intents are systematically mis-escalated.

name: false_auto_handle

worst_example.reply: Thank you for contacting AmazonHelp. Please check Your Account > Your Payments > Transactions for detailed breakdown. For unrecognized charges, we will investigate with our billing team. Please let us know if you need any additional assistance.

pattern: System auto-handled a message that required human escalation. Most dangerous failure — customer gets wrong/insufficient help.
proposed_fix: Lower escalation threshold for low-evidence cases. Add explicit check: if resolution_confidence='low', always escalate.

name: low_confidence_misclassification

worst_example.customer_message: I returned my package 7 days ago with tracking but still no refund on my card.
worst_example.reply: Thank you for contacting AmazonHelp. To return your item, go to Your Orders, select the item, and click Return or Replace Items to generate a prepaid label. Please let us know if you need any additional assistance.

pattern: Classifier was uncertain (low confidence) AND wrong. These should ideally be caught by the escalation policy.
proposed_fix: Ensure confidence_threshold is high enough to catch these. If threshold is already 0.65+, investigate why classification was uncertain.
